arStrings.szText:
Damaging a Close enemy with {c_important}Marksman{/c} or {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skills each grant a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed bonus for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

While both Attack Speed bonuses are active, you deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1x%|]{/c} increased damage to Close enemies.
